args.summary: checkout-api deploy v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Mitigation: rolled back production to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy release, in all regions. Post-rollback health checks are passing and the error rate is back to 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before attempting a redeploy; new deploy will require change-manager approval if v2.3.1 has not been healthy in production.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions. Post-rollback the service is healthy with the error rate back down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: Filed **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the mitigation performed. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: any attempt to redeploy v2.3.1 (which has never been healthy in production) will require change-manager approval per policy.
